question.text: The coordinates of a moving point \(p\) are \(\left(2 t^2+4,4 t+6\right)\). Then its locus will be a

solution.text:
Hints: \(x=2 t^2+4, y=4 t+6, \quad y=4 t+6 \rightarrow t=\left(\frac{y-6}{4}\right)\)
\(\begin{aligned}
& x=2\left(\frac{y-6}{4}\right)^2+4 \Rightarrow \frac{(y-6)^2}{8}=x-4 \\
& (y-6)^2=4(2)(x-4)
\end{aligned}\)
